label: Deviation
tooltip: Compare the scan with the bodies in colour
help: The deviation is the distance of every scan point to the nearest body surface: positive where the scan lies outside (excess material), negative where it lies inside. Points farther than the maximum search distance stay grey. D switches the colour display on and off.
rangeTooSmall: The range must be larger than {{min}} (3 × tolerance). Until then the automatic range applies.
verdictFailed: Only {{share}} of the scan points are within the tolerance of ±{{tolerance}}. Check the bodies and the alignment.
